business_problem: Shengshu Technology needed a controllable and cost-effective infrastructure for rapidly training and iterating its multimodal video model while ensuring compute continuity, storage performance, and enough downstream scenarios to validate commercialization.
solution_summary: Shengshu Technology used Huawei Cloud to productionize Vidu, its self-developed multimodal video model, on a controllable domestic AI stack. Ascend Cloud Service supplies the main training and inference compute, while ModelArts provides the end-to-end development toolchain so hardware or network faults do not interrupt jobs. SFS Turbo AI storage supports high-bandwidth, low-latency data loading, snapshot writes, and recovery during model training. Shengshu also manages multi-environment infrastructure through crossplane and IaC so the base model can iterate quickly without operational bottlenecks. The resulting pipeline supports long-duration, high-consistency, multi-subject video generation on the Vidu platform and gives Shengshu a repeatable way to move image and video models from training into global production scenarios such as entertainment, animation, and marketing.

data_flow: Training data is loaded through SFS Turbo into Ascend compute jobs managed by ModelArts, with snapshots and recovery points written back to storage during iteration. The trained Vidu models are then served to batch video-generation workflows for global creators and enterprise use cases.
